[[Agent/Legends|Agent]] '''Flodon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] as a member of the [[Destabilization]] branch of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]]. After being surgically-altered to give him the appearance of a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], Flodon traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and participated in the [[Calamari Project]], an Imperial operation that aimed to spark a war between the Mon Calamari and [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
